body:
Acceptance update at `7cf6e7fd3841f0e63ae56d5a9cc1459920193b41`:

- **Scope exception approved:** the maintainer approved keeping the required correctness fixes and regression coverage together at 1,267 gross changed lines. This is a scoped exception to the 1,000-line PR budget, not a readiness waiver.
- **Stalled iOS capture investigated:** [run 33985544618](https://github.com/callstack/agent-device/actions/runs/33985544618), at `e84bdc15d4`, shows the fixture home screen correctly visible. Request `712353abbe3417aa` spent 4,650 ms connecting for runner `findText`, then target discovery hit its 3,000 ms `xcrun` timeout. Typed target-resolution fallback started with about 1.8 seconds left and was cancelled at the original request deadline. No bridge acquisition occurred. This identifies where the budget was spent; it does not establish the underlying cause of the slow connections or dismiss the failure as flaky. Fresh exact-head iOS validation remains required.
- **Foreground correctness:** the worker observed a normal bridge capture, then opened a microphone permission dialog in the same app process. `foreground-owner-unverified` triggered XCTest fallback, which returned the dialog and buttons rather than the covered app tree. The native guard and automatic iOS regression are committed. Local affected gates passed: 743 files / 5,671 tests.
- **Benchmark evidence remains pending:** the matched six-screen base/head corpus is not complete. A rebase is underway because upstream #2310 changed packaging and the size-report schema; the size job mixed reporter versions and failed before comparison. Final measurements will use the updated exact base/head, with earlier evidence retaining its original SHA attribution.

Still required before merge-readiness: publish the complete matched benchmark/public-response artifacts and obtain green final-head CI, including iOS. No new performance claim yet.

Sentinel review at 7cf6e7fd3841f0e63ae56d5a9cc1459920193b41: Two confirmed readiness gaps: (1) the new native-runtime.test.ts beforeAll hits the 10s hook timeout in iOS run33987768263, so its native regression never executes; use an explicit bounded compile/hook budget or smaller compilation scope and establish green CI. (2) foreground-owner.m calls only isPrimaryForegroundProcess, not snapshotForProcess: removing either new pre/post ownership guard leaves this test green. Add regression proof that deleting either guard fails and covered/changing ownership yields typed failure without publishing the app tree. The foreground-owner implementation otherwise matches the intended fallback policy. Matched benchmark/public-response artifacts remain pending, and Size has the cross-version reporter-schema failure. No readiness label.

Follow-up to the two findings in [this review](https://github.com/callstack/agent-device/pull/2279#issuecomment-5554446364):

1. **Compiler/setup timeout:** the current branch uses a 45-second compiler subprocess deadline and a separate 60-second `beforeAll` budget. Each test executable also has a 5-second deadline. This bounds the expensive setup without increasing the runtime test timeout indiscriminately. Green final-head iOS CI is still required; the earlier 10-second hook failure is not being treated as a passed regression.

2. **Guard-deletion proof:** I replaced the predicate-only test with five cases calling the actual `snapshotForProcess` entry point. The fixture compiles the production runtime with fake native dependencies and loader symbols; it does not copy the guards or add production test hooks. It exercises initialization, capture, both ownership checks, and tree materialization.

Observed with `pnpm exec vitest run packages/platform-apple/src/snapshot-source/native-runtime.test.ts`:

| Production mutation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Delete only the pre-acquisition guard | 3 failures: covered, missing, malformed ownership |
| Restore pre-guard; delete only the post-acquisition guard | 1 failure: changed ownership publishes the app tree |
| Restore both guards | All 5 pass |

Refusal cases assert no published tree, the exact typed ownership failure, request ID, and expected native acquisition count. The stable case requires a successfully materialized app tree, preventing an always-refuse implementation from passing.

The test-only change was independently handed to the implementation worker and is integrated locally, awaiting the serialized final gate and PR push. Production runtime code is unchanged by this test fix. This records completed regression proof, **not** final CI acceptance. The worker continues to own final-head iOS validation and the matched six-screen benchmark/public-response artifacts; those remain open until their evidence is published.
